brief:
今日经济线的关键词是 AI 盈利与 AI 举债：AI 相关公司将贡献美股三季度多数盈利增长，欧洲企业盈利同样逆势强劲，基本盘暂时无忧；但另一边超大规模云商为 AI 基建借入数千亿美元，Oracle、Broadcom、SpaceX 也在寻求创纪录发债买芯片，AI 泡沫争论从估值转向债务可持续性。政策面同样热闹：特朗普在最高法院力保库克留任后成立委员会调查美联储理事，中欧就管控中国混动汽车对欧出口达成谅解，印度则三年来首次加息并出台卢比维稳措施。点评一句：盈利兑现 vs 举债扩张的多空拉锯中，财报季和油价是接下来两周的胜负手。

- Top2：中国与欧盟就管控中国混动汽车对欧出口达成谅解——密集磋商后以符合 WTO 规则方式解决，避免贸易战升级。原文：https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111062
- Top3：特朗普成立委员会调查美联储理事库克——最高法院裁定库克可留任后，总统继续施压美联储。原文：https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111064
- Top4：印度三年来首次加息至 5.5%，央行并推卢比维稳组合拳——通胀加速叠加全球能源价格上行下的紧缩转向。原文：https://www.ftchinese.com/story/001111041

items.title: China Targets AI-Linked Jobs With New Employment Initiative
items.summary: China will launch an employment initiative aimed at adapting skills to the development of artificial intelligence, human-resources officials said at a State Council Information Office briefing on Saturday.

items.title: Taiwan’s Lai Urges Democracies to Unite After Trump-Xi Summit
items.summary: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te called on democracies in the region to unite against threats to stability, as the island faces pressure from Beijing and concerns that Donald Trump’s rapprochement with China could come at Taiwan’s expense.

items.title: India Masses Police in New Delhi as ‘Cockroach’ Protest Looms
items.summary: New Delhi woke to a tense Saturday as thousands of police and paramilitary personnel were deployed across the capital ahead of a demonstration by the Cockroach Janta Party over a contentious revision of India’s voter rolls.

items.title: RBI Announces Special Oil Window, Regulatory Steps for Rupee
items.summary: India’s central bank rolled out steps including a special window to supply dollars to state-run oil companies to support the rupee.

items.title: Thai Bourse Revises Short-Selling, High-Frequency Trading Rules
items.summary: Thailand’s stock exchange will roll out revised rules from Nov. 16, including changes to short-selling and high-frequency trading, as it seeks to improve market stability, liquidity and investor confidence, according to a filing.

items.title: Australia Says Doesn’t Need Russian Fuel After Trump Diesel Move
items.summary: Australia has no need to buy fuel from Russia and said that purchases from there will remain barred so that the country doesn’t benefit from the invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: Safari Park Plan Sparks Fresh Wave of Resident Angst in Vietnam
items.summary: In the rolling hills of Ba Vi mountain range just outside Hanoi, the planned construction of a new safari park is causing consternation among residents and has sparked a backlash against the development of an area of great natural beauty.

items.summary: Foreign investors are returning but find busted pipelines, chronic blackouts and an industry hollowed out by years of neglect.

items.title: Masked Thieves in Italy Make Off With $5.6 Million of High-End Wine
items.summary: The bandits used a company’s own forklifts to steal some 30,000 bottles of wine, including prized reds.

items.title: Oil Prices Steady After Trump Appears to Rule Out Iran Strikes Before Midterms
items.summary: Oil prices edged higher as traders weighed President Trump’s pledge not to attack Iran before the U.S. midterm elections against persistent shipping risks in the Persian Gulf and extensive offshore production shut-ins in the Gulf of Mexico.

items.title: How a Binance ‘High-Value Customer’ Established a Financial Lifeline for Iran

items.title: 特朗普成立委员会调查美联储理事库克
items.summary: 在美国最高法院裁定库克可以留任后，美国总统成立一个委员会来调查有关库克“在一项或多项抵押贷款相关文件中作出虚假陈述”的指控。

items.title: 中国与欧盟就控制中国混合动力汽车对欧出口达成谅解
items.summary: 中国商务部在声明中表示，经过密集磋商，中欧双方以符合世贸组织规则的方式，就混合动力汽车贸易达成谅解。

items.title: 星巴克研究收购奇波雷墨西哥烧烤的可能性
items.summary: 咖啡连锁巨头若与市值近390亿美元的奇波雷连锁餐厅联姻，将达成餐饮业有史以来规模最大的并购交易。

items.title: 安妮•卡森获2026年诺贝尔文学奖
items.summary: 现年76岁的加拿大作家，以其“大胆而富有创意的作品与古典传统展开灵动对话，为当代文学开创了新的形式”。

items.title: 沙特机场遭导弹袭击后百余航班取消
items.summary: 胡塞武装周四称其用弹道导弹袭击了哈立德国王国际机场。

items.title: 欧盟贸易专员访华谈判混合动力汽车出口问题
items.summary: 欧洲官员警告称，如果无法解决混合动力汽车的问题，北京会谈将以失败告终，这意味着两大经济体之间贸易关系可能迅速恶化。

items.title: 中国拒绝欧盟关于“自愿限制”混合动力汽车出口的请求
items.summary: 欧盟委员会正在考虑实施临时限制措施，以控制可能引发严重贸易冲突的中国混合动力汽车出口激增。

items.title: 大众就汽车融资丑闻拨备7.25亿英镑
items.summary: 这起巨额丑闻源于汽车经销商在协助购车者办理贷款时，未充分披露自己将获得的佣金。整个汽车行业因此遭受的冲击已超过15亿英镑。

items.title: 印度3年来首次加息
items.summary: 央行货币政策委员会一致投票决定加息0.25点，至5.5%，依据是通胀加速、全球能源价格上涨以及印度经济增长强劲。

items.title: 德国阻止中资收购汉堡港物流企业
items.summary: 德国否决中远海运收购康拉德•齐佩尔货运代理80%股份。上届德国政府曾批准中远海运入股汉堡港一集装箱码头。
